customer_maya 1763456789: Hey — after our IdP rotated certs at ~09:10 UTC we're seeing intermittent 403s on SSO. About 10-20% of attempts fail with 'Assertion recipient mismatch' or 'Signature verification failed: cert not found'. Happening across EU/US regions. Repro: SSO -> IdP -> callback /saml/acs -> 403. We pushed new metadata to IdP earlier today. Can you triage?
jordan_support 1763456793: Sorry you're hitting this, we'll dig in. Can you paste the exact ACS URL you're sending? Also any example saml_response or request_id from the failed attempt?
customer_maya 1763456801: ACS URL is https://app.customer.example.com/saml/acs (no trailing slash). Example log: `request_id=abc123 SAML error: RecipientDoesNotMatch expected="https://app.customer.example.com/saml/acs" got="https://app.customer.example.com/saml/acs/"` — some callbacks have trailing slash. Not sure if IdP sometimes appends it.
neha_oncall 1763456805: thanks — two likely possibilities: (1) our metadata cache hasn't picked up the new IdP cert so signature verification fails for assertions signed with the new key, or (2) the IdP is returning inconsistent Recipient/ACS values (trailing slash). We'll check metadata polling and CDN cache.
eli_infra 1763456810: quick check — can you run `curl -i "https://idp.customer.example.com/metadata.xml"` and paste headers? looking for cache-control / last-modified / 304 behavior. if the IdP updated metadata but returns 304 to our poller it might not refresh keys.
customer_maya 1763456815: headers: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/samlmetadata+xml
cache-control: public, max-age=300
last-modified: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:09:00 GMT` — metadata updated ~09:09. We rotated cert at 09:10 though, not sure.
jordan_support 1763456818: ok — our platform polls IdP metadata every 5m and respects cache-control/etag/last-modified. There is a small race: if IdP rotates cert and serves mixed metadata for a short window or uses redirects, our poller can see an older version. Also the trailing-slash mismatch would cause RecipientDoesNotMatch. Two prongs: verify metadata keys and normalize ACS on redirect.
neha_oncall 1763456820: action plan: (A) eli_infra — force metadata refresh for customer in admin console and purge our edge cache for their metadata URL; (B) jordan_support — ask customer to confirm IdP redirect URIs do not append trailing slash (or we can normalize on our side for this account temporarily); (C) deploy-bot — run quick health check for SSO success rate after fix.
eli_infra 1763456820: on it — I'll force-refresh metadata and purge CDN. If signature errors persist we'll temporarily accept both old/new certs for 30m for this tenant and follow up with a runbook change.
deploy-bot 1763456820: scheduled job: sso-health-check for tenant customer.example.com queued, ETA 3m. results -> thread when done.
jordan_support 1763456820: thanks team. @customer_maya we'll ping here when refresh/purge is complete, and can also provide a short-lived upload link if you want to push metadata directly to us to avoid polling races. For long-term, we'll add a grace window on key rotation and a note in the cert-rotation KB. :thumbsup:
customer_maya 1763456820: thanks — appreciate the quick triage. we'll hold on our rotation for 30m until you confirm.
